name: Unreviewed depreciation parameters -> charge and carrying amount risk
rationale: Depreciation parameters set in the past drift from economic reality without periodic review. The rule directs the auditor beyond arithmetical accuracy (recalculation) to the appropriateness of the parameters themselves (evaluation against usage, condition and industry practice), plus testing of change controls.
